meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

copy.tagline: 把基因序列分析与文献检索自动化成流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理 DNA/蛋白质序列或需要批量查询 NCBI 文献与数据库。
copy.tagline_en: Automate sequence analysis and NCBI lookups in pipelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely handle DNA/protein sequences or need batch NCBI queries.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Biopython 做生物计算:读写与转换 FASTA、GenBank、PDB 等序列文件,做序列比对、BLAST 搜索、经 Entrez 取 NCBI/PubMed 数据,以及构建和绘制进化树。
howto.when: 当你提出处理 DNA/RNA/蛋白质序列、解析生物文件格式或访问 NCBI 数据库等任务时,它会接管,并按需要去读对应的参考文档。

howto.what_en: Claude uses Biopython for biological computing: reading, writing and converting FASTA/GenBank/PDB files, sequence alignment, BLAST searches, NCBI/PubMed fetches via Entrez, and building or drawing phylogenetic trees.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you work with DNA/RNA/protein sequences, parse biological file formats, or access NCBI databases; it then reads the matching reference docs.
